strengths.title: GST without the spreadsheet
strengths.summary: GST bills with the CGST/SGST split and HSN summary; GSTR-1 and 3B built from your own bills; GSTR-2B matched to purchases.
strengths.headline: Your GSTR-1 is ready the moment you bill.
strengths.text: Returns are built from the bills themselves on every read, so a cancelled invoice simply drops out. No export, no re-typing.
points: GST invoice with CGST/SGST or IGST and an HSN summary
GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B for a month or a quarter
GSTR-2B import, matched to your purchase bills
E-invoice export for the portal, and the tax calendar on Home

strengths.title: Schemes your principals run
strengths.summary: Free goods, slab discounts, coupons and offers that stack or give the best one; claims raised back to the principal.
strengths.headline: Buy 10, get 1 free. Worked out on every bill.
strengths.text: Offers apply on their own while you bill, and the bill shows what the customer saved. What the principal funds is raised back to them as a claim.
points: Free goods, slab and quantity discounts, coupons
Stack offers, or give only the best one
Try an offer before it goes live
Principal claims for schemes, expiry and damage

strengths.title: Order to cash, in one chain
strengths.summary: Quotation, order, delivery, bill and receipt, each continuing the last, with approvals and credit limits that warn before it is too late.
strengths.headline: From the salesman's order to the money in the bank.
strengths.text: Each step carries the price, discount and free goods of the one before it, so an agreement is never quietly rewritten. Switch off the steps a small firm does not type.
points: Quotation → order → delivery → bill → receipt
Up to three levels of approval by amount
Credit limits that warn, or block if you choose
Customer statements and ageing that add up

strengths.title: Stock you can trust
strengths.summary: Batches and expiry, many warehouses, transfers in transit, cases and pieces, and reorder from what actually sells.
strengths.headline: Know what expires before it does.
strengths.text: Every movement is in the stock ledger, by branch and warehouse. Pick the batch on the delivery, and see what is near expiry while there is still time to sell it.
points: Batch and expiry on every line
Many branches and warehouses, transfers in transit
Cases, boxes and pieces converted for you
Reorder from set levels or from sales

strengths.title: Beats, routes and salesmen
strengths.summary: Routes and beat plans, call lists, targets and commission with slabs, caps and payouts.
strengths.headline: Every salesman, every beat, every day of the week.
strengths.text: Plan who visits which shop on which day, set targets, and pay commission on sales or margin, with ladders and caps.
points: Routes, beats and weekly to monthly plans
Call lists in visiting order
Targets by person and period
Commission ladders, caps and payouts

strengths.title: Books that keep themselves
strengths.summary: Bills, receipts, payments and stock post to the ledger as you work; trial balance, P&L, balance sheet and bank reconciliation.
strengths.headline: Your accountant opens the books. They are already written.
strengths.text: Eleven kinds of documents post their own journal entries, so the ledger and the stock always agree. Close a year when you are ready.
points: Automatic posting from bills, receipts and stock
Trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet
Bank statements matched to the ledger
Cheques, payment runs and TDS/TCS

strengths.title: Many firms, one sign-in
strengths.summary: Run every firm from one place, each with its own books, numbering and GST registration. Switch firm in a click.
strengths.headline: Two agencies, one wholesale firm, one sign-in.
strengths.text: Each firm keeps its own books, numbering, branches and GSTINs. Your people see only the firms they work for, and only what their role allows.
points: Separate books and numbering per firm
A GSTIN per branch
Roles decide who can see and do what
Switch firm without signing out

strengths.title: Safe on your own server
strengths.summary: Runs on your own PC or office server. A trail of every change that nobody can edit, and a backup before every update.
strengths.headline: Your data stays in your office.
strengths.text: The server runs on your own machine. Every change is recorded in a trail that cannot be edited, and every update backs up the database before it touches anything.
points: Runs on your PC or office server, no internet needed
A change history nobody can rewrite
Backup before every update
Import your products, parties and opening balances from a file
